name: Strahd's Animated Armor

source.note: Curse of Strahd appendix block (2016) in the 2024 layout. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Shocking Bolt's +4 to hit (low for the block) and any traits (the plain 2014 animated armor has Antimagic Susceptibility and False Appearance; none are entered) need the book. Blind beyond its blindsight. Multiattack lets it mix one Greatsword swing with one Shocking Bolt (the book: two swings or two bolts).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Greatsword attacks, or Shocking Bolt twice.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.summary: A heavy sword that crackles with lightning.

actions.name: Shocking Bolt
actions.summary: Hurls a bolt of lightning up to 60 ft.

summary: Strahd's own war armor, walking on its own: a lightning-charged greatsword and bolts from range.
